queries.rawSQL:
select count(host) as counter
from(
select  site_name,
        operational_status,
        k.host
from  ( 
  select
	i.*,
	device.maya_os_version
from
	maya_tenant.otlp_metric."" as i
	left join envanter.public.device device on i.device_id = cast(device.id as varchar)
) as k
where site_name is not null AND lower(operational_status) = 'active'    
Group by site_name,operational_status,k.host
) as k
